$comment: Stage spec: vuln_triage. L3 non-destructive vuln validation (nuclei / matching). Phase A.
$comment_formulaic: Attack-stage split (design 2026-07-02): vuln_triage is redefined as the FORMULAIC SCAN stage — batch-run tool+dictionary/template techniques whose verdict is relatively objective (n-day PoC, sensitive dirs, weak creds, TLS, info leak, shallow IDOR/SQLi/XSS/cmd-injection tool sweeps). Reasoning-heavy classes (SSRF/SSTI/LFI/auth-bypass logic/business logic) move to the attack_candidate stage. specialist=vuln_scanner lets stage_run fan out per org; facts_from_db_truth + freshness_window mirror the info-gathering matrix paradigm.

hints: add evidence to each claim via prior tool calls
add evidence to each finding via prior tool calls

on_fail.reason: every 'found' coverage cell must cite evidence
hints: attach a PoC / evidence id to each found cell

on_fail.reason: every 'checked_empty' coverage cell must cite evidence (I8: checked-empty is NOT unchecked)
hints: attach the scan/probe evidence id proving you actually tested this technique on this asset

gate_rules.$comment_authoritative: Phase 4 (gate-capability-ledger, incremental per design 2026-07-02 §11 open-Q3 + attack-stage plan P3 Task3.2): scope authoritative_found to the 4 most objective formulaic classes — n-day PoC (GOLISH-NDAY), sensitive exposure/config (WSTG-CONF-05), default/weak creds (WSTG-ATHN-02), TLS (WSTG-CRYP-03). For these, a hand-written 'found' no longer counts without a technique_outcomes DB fact; the deterministic nuclei handler (bridge_config.rs maybe_store_background_vuln_outcomes) upserts found/empty per covered WSTG class from -tags + JSON hits, so real scans close these cells and self-report cannot inflate them. The other 6 classes (INPV-05/01/12, ATHZ-04, SESS-02, INFO) keep legacy self-report until their scan write-paths land, so the live gate never permanently blocks (escape hatch: blocked/not_applicable+note still terminal for any class). Widen authoritative_techniques as more scanners upsert (design guardrail 2).

on_fail.reason: coverage incomplete: some (asset × expected technique) cells were never attempted
hints: for every in-scope asset, give each expected technique a terminal status: found+evidence / checked_empty+evidence / blocked|not_applicable+note

on_fail.reason: coverage below denominator: a tested/total cell did not cover its enumeration surface and gave no sampling_rationale
hints: cover every enumerated unit (endpoint/param) for the technique on the asset, OR set sampling_rationale and raise tested_units to the required ratio
if the asset has no testable unit for this technique, use not_applicable + note instead of checked_empty

$comment_expected_techniques: 公式化扫描技术类（设计 2026-07-02 §3.9：只留工具+字典/模板能机械批量跑、判定相对客观的类，10 类）。SQLi=INPV-05, XSS=INPV-01, 命令注入=INPV-12（工具扫低垂果实层），IDOR=ATHZ-04（浅层替换批量），弱口令/爆破=ATHN-02, 会话/CSRF=SESS-02, 敏感暴露/配置=CONF-05, 传输/TLS=CRYP-03, 信息泄露=INFO, n-day=GOLISH-NDAY。需推理构造的类（SSTI=INPV-18, SSRF=INPV-19, 路径穿越/LFI=ATHZ-01, 认证绕过逻辑=ATHN-04, 业务逻辑=BUSL）移交 attack_candidate 阶段。coverage_complete 据此核每个自报资产是否每类技术都有终态（derive_from_evidence 补格：technique_outcomes 落库的真值也可关闭缺口）；coverage_denominator 再核每格是否对着 enumeration 分母测全（D6 默认全覆盖，抽样需 sampling_rationale）。
